title.zh-CN: 结肠癌治疗后的腹泻发热 · 56岁女性
title.en: Diarrhoea and fever after colon-cancer therapy · woman aged 56

summary.zh-CN: 延迟性腹泻伴发热低压及中性粒细胞减少，需要整合药物代谢风险和急症处理。
summary.en: Delayed diarrhoea with fever, hypotension and neutropenia requires integration of pharmacogenetic risk and emergency care.

provenance.citation: 蔡炜嵩, 马赛男, 吴荣. 应用伊立替康治疗一例UGT1A1*28纯合变异型大肠癌患者的体会. 中华结直肠疾病电子杂志. 2013;02(05):256-257.

notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

notes.en: AI-assisted editorial check against the cited authorities, not licensed-clinician review. Rare presentations and source regimens still require specialist confirmation.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用症状相对给药时间识别延迟毒性。
learningOutcomes.en: Use timing relative to treatment to recognise delayed toxicity.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分药物基因易感性与个体安全剂量。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish pharmacogenetic susceptibility from an individual safe dose.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 将发热低压与中性粒细胞减少列为急症证据。
learningOutcomes.en: Identify fever, hypotension and neutropenia as emergency evidence.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对发热低压和中性粒细胞减少及时升级，避免自行复制剂量
learningOutcomes.en: Escalate fever, hypotension and neutropenia without copying doses for self-treatment

answer.en: Diarrhoea began on cycle day 13 and worsened over four days to six or seven watery stools daily.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：用症状相对给药时间识别延迟毒性。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：确切早期方案、感染培养、完整UGT1A1等位基因评估和长期结局；DOI尾点待核。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Use timing relative to treatment to recognise delayed toxicity. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Exact earlier regimen, infection cultures, full UGT1A1 allele assessment and long-term outcome; trailing DOI punctuation remains unresolved. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: UGT1A1*28纯合患者的严重延迟毒性；分次用药并不消除风险，历史方案矛盾保留。
conclusion.en: Severe delayed toxicity in UGT1A1*28 homozygosity; split dosing does not remove risk, and the historical regimen inconsistency is retained.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 用症状相对给药时间识别延迟毒性。
keyReasoning.en: Use timing relative to treatment to recognise delayed toxicity.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 区分药物基因易感性与个体安全剂量。
keyReasoning.en: Distinguish pharmacogenetic susceptibility from an individual safe dose.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 将发热低压与中性粒细胞减少列为急症证据。
keyReasoning.en: Identify fever, hypotension and neutropenia as emergency evidence.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 确切早期方案、感染培养、完整UGT1A1等位基因评估和长期结局；DOI尾点待核。
unknowns.en: Exact earlier regimen, infection cultures, full UGT1A1 allele assessment and long-term outcome; trailing DOI punctuation remains unresolved.
